description: Ship module (X 350) in REEF3D::CFD: 3D box barge (draft 0.15 m) floating in a two-phase level-set tank with a body-force propeller at fixed rps behind the stern; actuator disk as momentum source on the staggered velocity points (water part outside the hull), swirl without net force; surge, heave and pitch free, SSP-RK3 (N 40 3), 2 MPI ranks.
covers: sixdof_obj_cfd::actuator_forcing (staggered grids, water and body fractions, MPI sums)
